quality.hardDesign: 조건절(if)이 요구하는 반사실적 추론이 지문 속 두 개의 순차적 인과관계(전환 차량→정체, 경전철 확장→정체 해소)뿐 아니라 '경전철 연장이 앞당겨졌다'는 unlike/원래 일정 대비 조건 단서까지 함께 종합해야 풀리도록 설계했고, 오답 3개는 각각 무관한 세부(B), 원인·결과 방향 왜곡(C), 범위 과장(D)이라는 서로 다른 오개념을 갖도록 구성해 부분적 사실 일치만으로는 소거되지 않게 했다.

problem.passage:
Transportation historians examining the removal of the elevated Gardiner-style waterfront expressway in the fictional port city ofRavenmouth during the early 1990s have generally described the project as a clear victory for reviving downtown waterfront access: the expressway was torn down and replaced with a boulevard and public esplanade, and through-traffic counts on that stretch fell sharply within two years. However, transit planners who had modeled freight and commuter flows across the wider harbor district before demolition noticed something the simple corridor count conceals: total vehicle entries into the harbor district as a whole declined only modestly, since a large share of drivers who had used the expressway did not stop driving but instead diverted onto the inland arterial roads that ringed the old rail yards. This diversion pushed congestion on those arterial roads to record levels for nearly four years, and it eased only after a light-rail spur connecting the rail-yard neighborhoods to downtown was extended westward, adding enough capacity to absorb the rerouted demand. Unlike the boulevard project itself, the light-rail extension had not originally been scheduled to open until years after the expressway's demolition, but planners moved up its completion once early congestion data from the arterial roads came in. If planners had instead kept the light-rail extension on its original, later schedule rather than accelerating it, ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
problem.stimulus: Transportation historians examining the removal of the elevated Gardiner-style waterfront expressway in the fictional port city ofRavenmouth during the early 1990s have generally described the project as a clear victory for reviving downtown waterfront access: the expressway was torn down and replaced with a boulevard and public esplanade, and through-traffic counts on that stretch fell sharply within two years. However, transit planners who had modeled freight and commuter flows across the wider harbor district before demolition noticed something the simple corridor count conceals: total vehicle entries into the harbor district as a whole declined only modestly, since a large share of drivers who had used the expressway did not stop driving but instead diverted onto the inland arterial roads that ringed the old rail yards. This diversion pushed congestion on those arterial roads to record levels for nearly four years, and it eased only after a light-rail spur connecting the rail-yard neighborhoods to downtown was extended westward, adding enough capacity to absorb the rerouted demand. Unlike the boulevard project itself, the light-rail extension had not originally been scheduled to open until years after the expressway's demolition, but planners moved up its completion once early congestion data from the arterial roads came in. If planners had instead kept the light-rail extension on its original, later schedule rather than accelerating it, ______
problem.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?
options: the arterial roads ringing the old rail yards would likely have stayed severely congested for a longer stretch of time, since the diverted drivers would have lacked the added capacity that eventually relieved them
the public esplanade along the waterfront would have seen a temporary drop in pedestrian use during the same years
total vehicle entries into the harbor district would have risen well above pre-demolition levels within the boulevard corridor itself
transit planners would have concluded that removing the expressway failed to reduce car dependency throughout Ravenmouth as a whole
problem.explanation: 지문은 세 단계를 종합해야 정답에 도달한다: (1) 고속도로 철거 후 전환 차량이 내륙 순환도로에 정체를 유발, (2) 이 정체는 경전철 연장이 개통되어 수요를 흡수한 뒤에야 해소, (3) 그런데 이 연장은 원래 더 늦게 개통될 예정이었으나 정체 데이터를 본 계획자들이 앞당겼다는 조건 단서. 따라서 만약 연장을 원래 일정대로(늦게) 유지했다면, 정체를 흡수할 추가 용량이 없었을 것이므로 순환도로 정체가 더 오래 지속되었을 것이라는 A가 정답이다. B는 지문이 언급하지 않은 에스플러네이드 보행량이라는 무관한 세부를 끌어와 화자가 다루는 인과관계와 무관한 개념을 섞은 오답이다. C는 '도심 전체 통행량이 크게 줄지 않았다'는 사실을 '대로 구간 내부 통행량 증가'로 범위를 왜곡하고 원인(경전철 지연)과 결과(통행량 변화)를 잘못된 대상에 연결한 원인·결과 전도형 오답이다. D는 좁은 범위(순환도로 정체 해소 시점)의 이야기를 도시 전체 프로젝트 성패 평가로 과도하게 일반화한 범위 과장형 오답이다.
